_about: Words that mark a cost item as containing a hazardous material. Keyed by hazard id; the id is what the API returns and what the frontend translates (costs.hazard_<id>). Terms are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the item description, so a stem covers its compounds (asbest -> Asbestzement). Cover every language a cost database ships in. Adding a language or a hazard is a data change here, never a code change. 'exclude' lists the phrases that deny the hazard (asbestos-free, sans amiante); they are removed from the text before the terms are matched, so a safe product is neither badged nor demoted.
